items.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998
items.q: he talked to some gruffy Admiral of the Royal Navy and another man by the name of Andy Cannon who ran the Air Transport Command

ctx.x: That’s amazing. And then you flew some for the United States, too.

Then I came, I did a show, I went back to England on leave because I’d heard so much about the Miller band. And I flew back to London – I got leave and flew to London to hear it, and I arrived there before the band had arrived yet. There were rumors naturally. © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-

And I ran into Crosby, Bing Crosby, who said, “I’m doing a benefit tonight” well not a benefit, but, “I’m doing a USO show at this club tonight, why don’t you come and play a couple of tunes with me?” And I was a Flying Sergeant, and in RAF you didn’t go to quarters where the officers — you just didn’t step across that line. And I told this to Bing and he said “if you don’t go I don’t go, it’s very simple, so come and have dinner afterwards.” And he talked to some gruffy Admiral of the Royal Navy and another man…
